title: Minimum Viable Signal: Venture Funding, Social Movements, and Race
authors: Matt Marx; Qian Wang; Emmanuel Yimfor
eligible_reason: Single common event date: post_gf = (quarter >= tq(2020Q2)) for every unit (_6_preprocessing.do lines 16-17, 71-74, 133-153, 173-180; _2_building_regsfullsamplenew.do line 24). Treatment contrasts are Black-founded vs other startups (Tables 2-3, 8), or no-prior-alignment / only-white-partner investors vs others (Tables 4-7), all switched on at 2020Q2; the second date post_omc (2021Q4) is also common to all units. No staggered adoption, so no Hull-eligible design. Every column also includes time-varying age/ln_age.
design_notes: Stata. PitchBook startup-quarter panel (Tables 2-3, A.2-A.3; FE companyid quarter industrysector state_fips, cluster companyid; controls age), investor-quarter panel (Tables 4-6, A.5-A.6; investorid + quarter FE, ln_age control; Table 4 cols 1-2 have post_gf with state or investor FE only), deal-investor and deal-lead-investor panels (Tables 7-8; multiple interaction regressors). Figures 1-2 and A.1 are event studies around 2020Q2 (pre_4..post_k quarter dummies x Black-founded) at one common date. Table 2 col 6 is ppmlhdfe (Poisson).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: All treated units switch on at 2020Q2 (George Floyd's murder); post_omc 2021Q4 is a second common date.

specs.exclusion_reason: common treatment date (2020Q2) for all treated startups; time-varying control age
specs.sample_condition: startupquarterdatasetshort; cols 3-5 restrict control group by race

specs.exclusion_reason: common treatment date (2020Q2); time-varying control ln_age

data_files_note: Package ships only .do files, README.docx and analysislog.log. README: PitchBook is proprietary and cannot be shared; LinkedIn data privately purchased; race classifications from Cook, Marx and Yimfor.
data_provenance_note: PitchBook licence; no data in package.
screener_notes: Not staggered: one common shock (2020Q2) with treatment defined by founder race or investor experience. Excluded on design and on data (not shipped).
